rule: On missing natural EOS or the existing short-gate20-copy token loop, retain the failed raw node, bisect the entire original input and decode both children. At most2levels; no child shorter than7.5s. Exhaustion is a failure. Early loop stop changes no generated prefix. No word deletion, VAD trimming, token-budget increase, model/prompt/weight change, reference or participant count.
normalOutputPolicy: Keep every accepted original raw ID/text exactly; same frozen policy across both whole meetings.
pilotCases: One unchanged actual30s must match native1.7B recorded IDs/text; longest real audio-only selected root must retain all input mel frames (no30s truncation); exact-zero-only pipeline guard reused. No accuracy claim before same full meeting scoring.
changedParameterScope: Only additional predicted speaker-change root cuts; original native inference/recovery/language/padding/weights unchanged
boundaryPolicy: Exact author low-energy rule, same local30s budget; search±5s/minimum100ms absolute-amplitude window; source-required short-tail padding only. No VAD trimming.

turnBoundaryPolicy.additionalCuts: Predicted native single-speaker onset when anonymous identity changes from previous single-speaker run
turnBoundaryPolicy.cutPosition: Original predicted onset rounded to source sample, without padding or threshold adjustment
turnBoundaryPolicy.preservation: Keep every original boundary and every source sample once; original short-tail pad to8000 samples remains explicit
turnBoundaryPolicy.source: Only frozen predicted activity, audio and existing rule; no ASR words, references, true people or score-driven cut selection
turnBoundaryPolicy.stopping: One complete new ordinary development case, then the previous ordinary regression case. No cut-duration or onset-offset sweep.
